findings.text: 已在 DSH 中起草任务、需要整理输入并确认原约束的用户，可以从当前编辑器预览改写。见 [Q01](#research-q01)。

包声明宿主与 Web 客户端。兼容范围来自包清单，未验 registry 产物。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 兼容 DSH Web、编辑器插槽 | GUI 功能需要 | 注册按钮和撤销栏 | 核宿主及入口兼容 |
| 已配置宿主 LLM 路由 | 改写需要 | 生成新稿 | 报缺少模型或路由 |
| 可访问的近期会话 | 上下文模式可用时 | 补充指代及任务信息 | 回退为单稿增强 |
| 用户审阅 | 填回需要 | 确认原约束未丢失 | 保留草稿并放弃输出 |

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 测试模型调用 | 配模型与上下文 | 接入时间未测 |
| 持续 | 每次改写的模型 token 与延迟 | 核事实和约束 | 净节省未知 |
| 恢复 | 重试可能再消耗模型 | 放弃结果或核原稿 | 取消后费用未知 |
可用一个不含敏感信息的短草稿试用。输出漏约束、引用旧稿或编造环境时放弃填回，回原稿手动改。见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 原稿保护 | 预览与填回分开，立即撤销 | 多窗口、刷新及宿主行为 |
| 内容质量 | 使用宿主模型和可选历史 | 约束完整性与节省时间 |
| 限制与取消 | HTTP 并发和 AbortSignal | 提供方实际中止及费用 |

以保留全部关键约束的一次改写计量。
宿主和客户端边界明确，流式输出与最终结果分开。撤销仅在草稿匹配时生效，HTTP 与命令的限流范围不同。
把模型改写接到当前 DSH 草稿，用户可以审阅、选择填回并立即撤销。见 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
过时结果仍可手工填回，用户需要核对最新草稿。上下文感知还可能把近期会话文本送给所选模型。见 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。
可在预览中添加约束保留检查，对照是否减少漏项与人工修订。若无改善，则用原稿手工调整。见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

technical.rationale: 相对另开聊天改稿，宿主内的原稿、预览和撤销是局部集成。旧稿提示与撤销条件可迁移给其他编辑器，模型能力沿用宿主。减少复制步骤，仍需人工审阅。见 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)。

business.rationale: 在已有编辑区减少一次复制与窗口切换，产出仍是提示词。适合有宿主模型的用户。模型调用和复核增加成本，节省时间需对照。见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

recommendation.reason: 在 DSH 编写任务的用户，可以试用一份不含敏感内容的短草稿。比复制到另一个会话，它能在当前编辑器对照模型改写、按需填回并立即撤销。发现遗漏约束、过时草稿或虚构细节时，应放弃填回并回原稿手工编辑。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 说明重复草稿任务、人工比较和验收条件，超过偶发便利。未测用户频率和阻碍程度，未达较充分。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 的 EnhanceButton 160–177 与 UndoBar 32–48 有明确原稿恢复，比复制入口多出可逆编辑，超过局部包装。实际改写质量不明，未到较充分。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 至 [Q03](#research-q03) 追真实宿主请求、失败和填回，超过局部声明。未运行同版宿主和模型，止于源码。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 明确人工退出和保留原稿，超过恢复缺失。每次模型成本和文本审核未知，未达较轻。

enhancement for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web GUI** — one click turns a rough composer draft into a well-structured prompt: explicit role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, and edge cases. Your intent is never changed, nothing is fabricated, and the original draft is always preserved.\n\nEnglish | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)\n\n---\n\n## Why\n\nGood agent prompts state *who the model should be*, *what to deliver*, *in what format*, and *how success is judged*. Most drafts don't. This plugin adds a **WorkBuddy-style \"enhance\" affordance** to the dsh composer: it sends your draft through a low-temperature rewrite pass (via the harness's own LLM service), shows the result next to the original, and lets you apply, copy, or discard it. Undo is one click away, and every failure path leaves your draft exactly as you typed it.\n\n## Features\n\n| | |\n|---|---|\n| ✨ **Composer button** | A small button in the input box's tool row (next to the send button), always at hand |\n| 🔀 **Preview panel** | Original vs. enhanced side by side, with model name and elapsed time |\n| ↩️ **One-click undo** | After applying, a quiet bar above the composer restores the original draft |\n| ⌨️ **Shortcut** | Default `Ctrl+Alt+E`, fully configurable, acts on the composer you are working in |\n| 💬 **`/enhance` command** | Rewrite any text from the slash-command plane; the result never enters model history |\n| 🧠 **Model routing** | Settings pair → current session model → harness default model, in that order |\n| 🔑 **Zero credential setup** | Calls ride the harness LLM service; keys come from the harness credential store |\n| ⚙️ **Live settings** | Every knob (model override, temperature, budgets, system prompt, shortcut) hot-applies from Settings → 插件配置 |\n| 🛡️ **Draft safety** | Empty, over-length, images-only, and command-chip inputs are rejected locally; upstream failures are mapped to readable messages; the draft is never mutated on failure |\n\n![The preview panel running in dsh web: original and enhanced prompt side by side with model info, fill-back and copy actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rongxingda/dsh-prompt-enhance/main/docs/evidence-prompt-enhance-panel.png)\n\n## How it works\n\n```mermaid\nflowchart LR\n A[Composer draft] --> B{Local guards
empty / length / chips / busy}\n B -- pass --> C[\"POST /prompt-enhance/enhance
(loopback-fenced host route)\"]\n B -- reject --> P[Preview panel:
readable error, draft untouched]\n C --> D[\"ctx.llm.stream
rewrite with system strategy\"]\n D --> E[Normalize:
strip fences, trim, refuse empty]\n E --> F[Preview panel:
original / enhanced]\n F -- Apply --> G[\"setDraft(enhanced)
original pushed to undo stack\"]\n F -- Cancel / Copy --> H[Draft untouched]\n G --> U[Undo bar: one click restores]\n```\n\nThe plugin is one npm package with two halves, following the dsh plugin conventions:\n\n- **Host half** (`exports \".\"`, Node): declares the `prompt-enhance` settings schema (schemastery, every field marked `.volatile()` — the host's `describe()` **drops any entry with no volatile field**, so that mark is both what makes the config page appear and the contract for \"edits apply to the next request\"; the plugin **re-reads it on every request** instead of caching the boot snapshot), registers the `POST /prompt-enhance/enhance` route on the shared webserver (loopback-fenced, body-capped), and the `/enhance` slash command. The model call goes through `ctx.llm.stream` with a normalized output pass — the same auxiliary-call discipline the harness applies to session titles: deadline + caller cancellation rechecked during and after the stream, terminal-finish validation, tool-call rejection.\n- **Browser half** (`exports \"./client\"`): registers the enhance button into the `conversation.input.right` slot and the undo bar into `conversation.input.dock`, binds a live mirror of the settings namespace, and installs the global shortcut. All copy is localized (zh/en) through the harness locale system.\n\n## Requirements\n\n- `dsh >= 0.1.1-rc.2 < 0.3.0` — the range states what has actually been exercised, not an open-ended promise.\n- Boot-verified on `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.1.2-alpha.3`, `0.1.7-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and **`0.2.1-rc.5`** (layer mounts, enhance route answers, client bundle builds; on alpha the plugin takes the newer `ctx.settings.installSection` registration path, and on `0.2.0-rc.2` it also passes the runtime's plugin-compatibility gate). `0.2.1-rc.5` was checked by diffing every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` package the plugin builds against: apart from `dsh-client-ui-conversation`, whose `lib/` gained a View-tabs More menu and a `whenDraftExists` option on draft initialization, the published trees are **byte-identical** to `0.2.1-rc.2`, and none of the additions touch a contract this plugin uses. On a temporary profile at `rc.5` the plugin composed into the loader tree, `/prompt-enhance/enhance` answered with a real model result, `/enhance-stream` emitted live SSE deltas, and the host's own schema dump showed the entry as `config100` with **every field carrying `x-cordis.volatile`** — 16 of 16 on that run, 17 of 17 once `reasoningEffort` landed — the exact condition `SettingsForms.describe()` checks before it renders a page. The `0.2.1-rc.2` check is a **real-host end-to-end smoke**: with the local build installed into a temporary profile, the enhance route returned a real model result; setting that profile's `maxInputChars` to `300` made a 400-character draft fail with `422 {count: 400, max: 300}`, and after editing the same profile to `20000` — **without restarting** — the identical draft went through, so a settings edit reaches the *next* request instead of staying at the boot-time snapshot.
